opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must hold a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers, be experienced researchers, be resident in the United Kingdom, and be permanent members of the UK scholarly community.
opportunities.summary: Supports experienced researchers, particularly those prevented by routine duties from completing a research programme, with fellowships up to £70,000, tenable 3–24 months.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities and eligible UK independent research institutes may apply; applicants must be employed by the eligible institution and hold a research degree.
opportunities.summary: Provides research staff costs and associated costs for innovative projects up to five years, with a maximum grant of £500,000.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: £56,000 in year one, £28,000 in years two and three

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post, hold a doctorate, are UK residents and are based at a UK university.
opportunities.summary: Supports early-career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work; up to 145 fellowships in 2027, tenable 36 months.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired researchers who have a UK university or eligible research institute affiliation, are UK residents, and have an established research record.
opportunities.summary: Supports senior retired researchers to complete a research project; tenable 3–24 months, must commence between 1 August 2027 and 1 July 2028.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships (Centenary)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications are made by UK universities with research degree awarding powers; individual students are not eligible to apply directly.
opportunities.summary: Centenary doctoral scholarships for up to 30 scholarships per university, including support for master's-plus-PhD routes and limited post-doctoral opportunities; total award up to £5 million over nine years.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under 18s
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities in the UK may apply; individual students cannot apply directly.
opportunities.summary: Funds arts training for school-age children under 18 outside regular school hours; awards run for three years from 1 September 2025.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under/Postgraduate
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or charities may apply; individual students cannot apply directly.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries of £5,000–£10,000 per year for undergraduate or postgraduate arts students; awards may start between 1 September 2025 and 31 August 2027.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree awarding powers may apply, singly or collaboratively; institutions may submit one principal application.
opportunities.summary: Supports establishment of research centres for ambitious, transformative research up to ten years; funding up to £10 million.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university staff act as host; invites eminent senior overseas professors; institutions must approve and administer the grant.
opportunities.summary: Funds visits of eminent overseas scholars to UK institutions for 3–12 months, with a minimum award of £10,000.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career scholars with a permanent UK academic appointment, UK resident, who have not previously held a similar award or large research team.
opportunities.summary: Supports early-career scholars to build a modest research team and demonstrate leadership; awards up to £1 million for 4–5 years.
